settings.editor: The national authority connecting investors and exporters to Lebanon's strategic opportunities, world-class talent, and gateway to global markets.

settings.html:
<button id="aboutSidebarToggle" class="about-sidebar-toggle">‹</button>

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {

  const btn = document.getElementById("aboutSidebarToggle");
  const sidebar = document.querySelector(".about-sidebar");

  if (btn && sidebar) {
    btn.addEventListener("click", function () {

      sidebar.classList.toggle("about-sidebar-hidden");

      if (sidebar.classList.contains("about-sidebar-hidden")) {
        btn.innerHTML = "›";
      } else {
        btn.innerHTML = "‹";
      }

    });
  }


  const sections = [
    { id: "who-we-are", index: 0 },
    { id: "our-services", index: 1 },
    { id: "investments-supported", index: 2 },
    { id: "organizational-structure", index: 3 }
  ];

  const navItems = document.querySelectorAll(".about-nav-item");

  function updateActiveItem() {
    let currentIndex = 0;

    sections.forEach(function(section, i) {
      const el = document.getElementById(section.id);

      if (el) {
        const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();

        if (rect.top <= 220) {
          currentIndex = i;
        }
      }
    });

    navItems.forEach(function(item) {
      item.classList.remove("active");
    });

    if (navItems[currentIndex]) {
      navItems[currentIndex].classList.add("active");
    }
  }

  window.addEventListener("scroll", updateActiveItem);

  updateActiveItem();

});
</script>

settings.title: Lebanon's official investment and export authority

settings.editor:
The Investment Development Authority of Lebanon (IDAL) is the public institution mandated to promote, facilitate, and protect investment in Lebanon, while supporting Lebanese exporters in reaching international markets.

Established to serve as a single point of contact for investors and exporters alike, IDAL works across priority sectors to attract capital, generate employment, and strengthen Lebanon’s position as a competitive, transparent destination for business and trade.

From licensing and incentives to market access and aftercare, IDAL provides end-to-end support that helps businesses launch, grow, and export with confidence.
Connecting investors, exporters, and local partners through curated introductions, trade events, and sector-specific networks.
Guiding investors through incentives, licensing, and regulatory approvals to launch and grow projects across Lebanon's priority sectors.
Helping early-stage and innovative companies access mentorship, funding pathways, and the resources to scale from Lebanon.
IDAL supports investors and exporters from first inquiry to long-term growth, through three core service lines.
A track record of facilitating investment and supporting Lebanese exporters across key sectors.
Governance and departments working together to deliver on IDAL's mandate.
